extDescription.message: Reorganize your Chrome bookmarks with AI — every change is previewed, confirmed, and undoable

scopeIntro.message: Check the folders you want TidyMark to reorganize.

scopeSafety.message: Unchecked folders are never read and never modified — no bookmark moves out of them, and none moves in.

sendErrChannelClosed.message: The background stopped before returning a result (the extension was just reloaded, or the browser suspended it). Please retry — finished batches are cached, so a retry is much faster.

sendErrContextInvalidated.message: The extension was reloaded, so this side panel is stale. Close it and open it again.

sendErrNoReceiver.message: Cannot reach the background. Make sure TidyMark is enabled at chrome://extensions, then reopen the side panel.

sendErrNoResponse.message: The background returned nothing — it may have been suspended. Please retry.

importDuplicates.message: $count$ of them are already in your bookmarks

importDeleteHint.message: Do not want it? Just delete that folder in Chrome.

prefsPrivacyKey.message: Your API key is stored in plain text in local browser storage and is never uploaded anywhere.

prefsPrivacyPayload.message: Only bookmark titles, domains, paths, and current folder names are sent to the model — never URL parameters or page contents.

prefsRebuildOn.message: Redesigns the whole folder tree and adds a number prefix (01, 02…) to every top-level folder in scope — including ones you created yourself and ones that receive no bookmarks this run. Second-level folders are only reordered if they already had numbers. The whole run can be undone.

prefsRebuildOff.message: Only moves bookmarks into folders that already exist. Never renames, merges, or deletes any existing folder.

prefsCleanBody.message: Deletes folders in scope that contain no bookmarks, including parents left empty after their children were cleared. Scope roots are never deleted, and undo restores the folders along with the bookmarks.

prefsGithubBody.message: Rewrites titles from the URL into "repo (owner)", keeping the file name when a specific file is bookmarked. This changes the bookmark's own name, not just its location, and can be undone. It is independent of the checkboxes above — once on, every GitHub bookmark in scope is rewritten.

prefsGroupTitle.message: Give these sites their own folders

prefsGroupBody.message: Each checked site becomes its own top-level folder, subdivided by topic inside. Only takes effect when "Rebuild the folder structure" is on.

structureIntroOne.message: The AI designed $folders$ top-level folder to hold $bookmarks$ bookmarks.

structureIntroOther.message: The AI designed $folders$ top-level folders to hold $bookmarks$ bookmarks.

structureHint.message: Rename or delete any folder you do not want, then continue to the move list. Numbering is reassigned automatically.

structureFallback.message: Delete a top-level folder and its bookmarks fall back to "Other"; delete a subfolder and they stay in its parent.

reviewSummaryOne.message: $total$ suggested move, $accepted$ selected. Unselected bookmarks stay where they are.

reviewSummaryOther.message: $total$ suggested moves, $accepted$ selected. Unselected bookmarks stay where they are.

reviewRenameFoldersOne.message: , and add a number prefix to $count$ existing folder (undoable)

reviewRenameFoldersOther.message: , and add number prefixes to $count$ existing folders (undoable)

reviewRenameBookmarksOne.message: $count$ GitHub bookmark title will also be normalized to "repo (owner)". That is controlled by a setting and is not affected by the checkboxes below.

reviewRenameBookmarksOther.message: $count$ GitHub bookmark titles will also be normalized to "repo (owner)". That is controlled by a setting and is not affected by the checkboxes below.

reviewCleanNote.message: Empty folders in scope will be cleaned up afterwards (undoable).

reviewEmpty.message: The AI thinks every bookmark in scope is already in a sensible place, so there is nothing to move. Try a messier folder, or turn on "Rebuild the folder structure" to redesign the tree.

resultFailedHint.message: Everything already applied can be fully undone with the button below.

resultTreeHint.message: The real bookmark tree. The number on the right is how many bookmarks that folder holds, including subfolders. Unselected moves were not applied, so those bookmarks are still where they were.

resultUndoneOne.message: Undo complete: $restored$ item restored, $folders$ created folders removed.

resultUndoneOther.message: Undo complete: $restored$ items restored, $folders$ created folders removed.

errBackgroundRecycled.message: The browser suspended the background and interrupted this run. Please retry.

errHostPermission.message: TidyMark needs permission to reach your model endpoint's domain. Retry and allow the permission.

errNoApiKey.message: No API key configured yet. Add one in Settings first.

errNoTargetFolders.message: No usable target folders in the selected scope. Turn on "Rebuild the folder structure", or pick a scope that contains subfolders.

errNoBookmarksBar.message: Cannot find the bookmarks bar, so importing is not possible.

errImportInvalidJson.message: This file is not valid JSON.

errImportUnsupportedFormat.message: This is not a TidyMark export, or its version is not supported.

errClassifyAllFailed.message:
AI analysis failed — no bookmark could be classified.
$reason$

logTreeStart.message: Designing folders from the tags of $count$ bookmarks

logTreeDone.message: Folder design complete: $new$ new folders created, $reused$ existing folders reused

logPinnedSkip.message: $count$ bookmarks grouped by domain, skipping AI classification

logClassifyFailed.message: $count$ bookmarks failed to classify and were left in place. Reason: $reason$

logTitleRewrites.message: $count$ GitHub bookmark titles will be normalized

logApplyDone.message: Reorganization complete: $executed$ steps run, $removed$ empty folders removed, $sorted$ folders renumbered

logApplyInterrupted.message: Reorganization interrupted: $executed$ steps run, $removed$ empty folders removed, $sorted$ folders renumbered

logUndoDone.message: Undo complete: $restored$ items restored, $folders$ new folders removed

logCancelRequested.message: Cancellation requested — finishing the current batch…
